meta.bar_specificity: Composite false-positive rate 3.1%, MEASURED on 225 frequency-matched arbitrary words (2026-07-29). Admission is still NECESSARY, NOT SUFFICIENT evidence of contestation: the gate detects side-linked structure that survives a same-frequency topic floor, which is a much stronger filter than the single-leg bar it replaced — that one ran at 74.7% on the same words, cleared information-free profiles at 88%, and cleared all five discourse-marker controls (`whatever`, `literally`, `maybe`, `honestly`, `basically`), which the specificity leg rejects. See docs/research/2026-07-29-bar-specificity-*.md.

bar_corpus.note: the per-creator collocate profiles the bar was computed from are stored with the floor run, so re-running the permutation pass reproduces these p and q values exactly even after the corpus has grown

meta.diagnostic_note: Each concept also carries `bar.diagnostic` — the pooled permutation p and its Benjamini-Hochberg q. That is a REPORTED DIAGNOSTIC and is NOT THE GATE. Its null is 'no side-linked structure in the pooled cross-side divergence', which at these frequencies is false for most words, so it certifies far too much: on the 435-term benchmark it admits 176 terms at 97.2% false-discovery proportion, including the preposition `through` at q=0.0016 — a stronger q than `community`. Read it as a second opinion on one leg, never as the confidence in the published claim.

selection.ranked_by: keyness (log-likelihood vs an external reference corpus)
selection.rule: DESIGN §3's two-leg gate: the cross-side gap must exceed the spread among same-side creators (exact permutation of a PERMANOVA pseudo-F, each creator one point), AND the term's divergence must fall in the top 5% of a frozen pool of up to 40 words of the same occurrence mass (x/÷sqrt(2)), chosen in hash order of the word. A band holding fewer than 40 eligible peers is reported short and marked `reduced_resolution`, never widened — widening it would answer a different question. Both legs at the same frozen vintage, or the term does not publish.

false_positive_rate.basis: measured on 225 frequency-matched arbitrary words, 2026-07-29; re-measured whenever a parameter moves
false_positive_rate.caveat: an upper bound on specificity, not a guarantee: the negative set assumes arbitrary same-mass words are uncontested, and two of its false positives (`religion`, `paul`) are plausibly genuine. This is a measured rate on a stated set — it is NOT an FDR and must not be read as one.

selection.note: Two different things, and only one is gated. Terms are ADMITTED by the two-leg bar but ORDERED by keyness, which carries no correction — so a high rank reflects distinctiveness and selection, not a stronger result. Treat the ordering as a reading order, not a ranking of confidence.

meta.bar_note: Each concept carries the DESIGN §3 two-leg significance bar: a cross-side difference in how a term is USED counts as a community difference only if it exceeds both the spread among same-side creators AND the divergence of same-frequency arbitrary words. Every concept here cleared both legs — the lane annotates only terms that do, because reading thousands of candidates with an LLM is not feasible. Terms that did not clear the bar are not deleted: they remain in the candidate pool with their statistics, unannotated.
